service.name: Live music for Sunday brunch
service.serviceType: A jazz duo, solo guitarist or pianist for brunch at restaurants, hotels and clubs, and for private brunches
service.description: Upright bass and guitar, a solo guitarist, a Spanish guitarist or a pianist playing the standards under a Sunday brunch at 65 to 72 dBA, for a restaurant's, hotel's or club's standing Sunday and for private brunches, the morning after a wedding, a bridal brunch, a shower or a birthday, across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: Can a restaurant or hotel book live music for brunch every Sunday?
faqs.a: Yes. A standing Sunday, weekly or monthly, runs on one contract with one personal contact for the run, and the configuration is the same every time: upright bass and guitar, a solo guitarist, or a pianist where the dining space has a piano. Tell us the seating times and the space and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price for the run.

65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, which is the level of a conversation, and a duo or a solo can't drift above it by accident. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks, so the dining space never goes silent between them.

faqs.q: What music is played at a jazz brunch?
faqs.a: The standards and the bossa novas: Autumn Leaves, The Girl from Ipanema, All of Me, Blue Bossa, the songs everyone half-knows and nobody has to be told about, on upright bass and guitar. A singer with a guitar plays the folk and singer-songwriter songs instead, and the published song list is searchable on the repertoire page.

faqs.q: Can you play a post-wedding brunch or a bridal brunch?
faqs.a: Yes. The morning after a wedding, a bridal brunch, a shower or a birthday brunch is the same booking as a restaurant's Sunday: a duo, a guitarist or a pianist under the meal, at a hotel, a private dining space, a garden or a table at home. A duo that played the cocktail hour the day before can play the brunch on the same contract.

faqs.q: What does a dining space need?
faqs.a: A corner: 8 by 6 feet for a duo, 6 by 4 for a solo, and one outlet. Load-in takes 45 minutes to an hour before doors, and packing up takes 30 to 45 minutes after the last seating. On a patio, a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it or a battery-powered system.

faqs.q: How much does live music for brunch cost?
faqs.a: We publish no prices of our own. What a duo or a solo musician costs in this market, with sources, is on the pricing page, and a standing Sunday is priced as a run of dates. Send the Sunday and the space and we'll price it.
